seasons.name: Kharif-1
seasons.source_reference: Bangladesh Agricultural Research Council (BARC) Agro-Ecological Zones calendar

seasons.name: Kharif-2
seasons.source_reference: Bangladesh Agricultural Research Council (BARC) Agro-Ecological Zones calendar

seasons.name: Rabi
seasons.source_reference: Bangladesh Agricultural Research Council (BARC) Agro-Ecological Zones calendar

crops.name: Rice
crops.source_reference: BRRI (2022). Adhunik Dhaner Chash (Modern Rice Cultivation), 24th Ed., Section 2 (Aman), pp. 10-15; Section 5 (Disaster Mgmt), pp. 34-36.
crops.source_notes: Heat tolerance Medium (50.0): BRRI notes air temperature >35°C during anthesis (flowering) causes severe pollen desiccation and sterility ("chiTa"). Water demand High (75.0): 700-900 mm.

crops.name: Boro Rice
crops.source_reference: BRRI (2022). Adhunik Dhaner Chash, 24th Ed., Table 3 (Boro Varieties), pp. 18-22; Section 5 (Heat Sterility), pp. 34-36.
crops.source_notes: Growing days 145d: BRRI dhan28 (140d), BRRI dhan29 (160d), BRRI dhan96 (143d). Feasibility note: Under 120-day Rabi window without overlap (ALLOW_SEASON_OVERLAP=false), 145 > 120 triggers Fixture 13 ("Not seasonally feasible"), accurately reflecting that real Boro extends into April (Kharif-1). Heat tolerance Medium (50.0): susceptible to April heat shocks.

crops.name: T. Aman Rice
crops.source_reference: BRRI (2022). Adhunik Dhaner Chash, 24th Ed., Table 2 (Aman Varieties), pp. 10-14; BARC FRG (2018), p. 216.
crops.source_notes: Growing days 115d: BRRI dhan75 (110-115d) allows timely harvest before Rabi planting. Heat tolerance Medium (50.0). Tolerates submerged field conditions (waterlogging High).

crops.name: Aus Rice
crops.source_reference: BRRI (2022). Adhunik Dhaner Chash, 24th Ed., Table 1 (Aus Varieties), pp. 5-8.
crops.source_notes: Growing days 108d: BRRI dhan48 (106-110d). Fits comfortably in 122-day Kharif-1 window. Water demand Medium (50.0) compared to flooded Boro.

crops.name: Mung Bean
crops.source_reference: BARI (2019). Krishi Projukti Hatboi (Handbook of Agro-Technology), 8th Ed., Chapter 3 (Pulses - Mung), pp. 74-78.
crops.source_notes: Short duration 60-65d (BARI Mung-6). Water demand Low (25.0): 200-250 mm. Heat tolerance High (75.0): thrives in hot summer. Soil health High (75.0): fixes 30-50 kg N/ha. Waterlogging Low: highly sensitive to excess water.

crops.name: Lentil
crops.source_reference: BARI (2019). Krishi Projukti Hatboi, 8th Ed., Chapter 3 (Pulses - Lentil), pp. 66-70; FAO Irrigation and Drainage Paper 56.
crops.source_notes: Growing days 105-112d (BARI Masur-8). Water demand Low (25.0): 150-250 mm. Heat tolerance Low (25.0): BARI notes temperatures >30°C during pod filling severely reduce yield. Waterlogging Low: zero tolerance to water stagnation.

crops.name: Mustard
crops.source_reference: BARI (2019). Krishi Projukti Hatboi, 8th Ed., Chapter 4 (Oilseeds - Mustard), pp. 130-136.
crops.source_notes: Water demand Low (25.0): BARI specifies only 1-2 light irrigations (20-25 DAS & 50-55 DAS, total 150-250 mm) or non-irrigated on residual moisture. Growing days 75-80d (BARI Sarisha-14). Waterlogging Low: sensitive to soil saturation.

crops.name: Wheat
crops.source_name: Bangladesh Wheat and Maize Research Institute (BWMRI)
crops.source_reference: BWMRI (2020). Wheat Cultivation Technology Handbook, Table 1 & Irrigation Schedule, pp. 6-10, 14-16.
crops.source_notes: Growing days 105-110d (BARI Gom-33). Water demand Medium (50.0): 350-450 mm across 3 irrigations (CRI, flowering, grain fill). Heat tolerance Medium (50.0): BARI Gom-33 combines blast resistance and heat tolerance.

crops.name: Potato
crops.source_reference: BARI (2019). Krishi Projukti Hatboi, 8th Ed., Chapter 6 (Tuber Crops - Potato), pp. 180-188.
crops.source_notes: Growing days 85-90d (BARI Alu-7 Diamant). Heat tolerance Low (25.0): night temps >20°C inhibit tuberization. Waterlogging Low: standing water causes anaerobic soft rot.

crops.name: Maize
crops.source_name: Bangladesh Wheat and Maize Research Institute (BWMRI) & BARI
crops.source_reference: BWMRI (2021). Maize Production Manual, Chapter 3 & 5, pp. 12-18; FAO Irrigation and Drainage Paper 56.
crops.source_notes: Growing days 115d (BARI Hybrid Maize-9). Water demand High (75.0): requires 4-5 irrigations in Rabi (500-650 mm). Heat tolerance High (75.0): C4 photosynthetic pathway.

crops.name: Chickpea
crops.source_reference: BARI (2019). Krishi Projukti Hatboi, 8th Ed., Chapter 3 (Pulses - Chickpea), pp. 79-83; BARC FRG (2018), p. 218.
crops.source_notes: Growing days 110-115d (BARI Chola-9). Water demand Low (25.0): deep taproot utilizes residual soil moisture in Barind tract. Heat tolerance Medium (50.0): tolerates higher heat than lentil, but flowering affected >32°C. Waterlogging Low: prone to collar rot in moist soils.

crops.name: Jute
crops.source_reference: BJRI (2020). Pat Utpadon Projukti (Jute Production Technology), Chapters 2, 4, 5, pp. 8-14, 22-26, 28-30.
crops.source_notes: Water demand Medium (50.0): rainfed crop (450-550 mm), does not require flooded irrigation. Heat tolerance High (75.0): vegetative harvest avoids flowering sterility. Soil health High (75.0): sheds 3.5-4.0 t/ha leaf litter returning organic matter. Waterlogging Low (Low): Tossa jute (C. olitorius) is intolerant of standing water.
